scope: All 19 raster illustrations currently referenced by the English and Russian nigiri recipe, including hero, mise, preparation, shaping panels/insets and serving.
method: Direct visual inspection of each shipped image. Anatomy requirement: one thumb and four fingers per hand. Visible digits and their connections were inspected; naturally occluded or cropped digits are recorded explicitly. This is a manual visual review, not an automated anatomical proof.
